# Spotify Plus Xposed module to customize the official Spotify app on Android ![GitHub Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.lenerd46.spotifyplus/total) ![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LeNerd46/SpotifyPlus) ![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/discord/1507540683429384233?logo=discord) ![Telegram Badge](https://telegram-badge.vercel.app/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@spotifypluscool) ![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spotify%20Version-9.1.94.1929-green?logo=spotify) ![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/LeNerd46/SpotifyPlus?color=lightgreen)
> [!IMPORTANT] > The latest recommended version of Spotify to use is v9.1.94.1929. The module is not guaranteed to work past this version ### Features * Change the colors and the theme of Spotify * Install custom extensions * Modify, extend, and add new features to Spotify * Take full control of the Spotify app and make it your own --- Interested in developing an extension? Check out the [documentation](https://lenerd46.github.io/spotifyplus-docs/docs/category/getting-started)! If you need any help or have any questions, feel free to reach out on [Discord](https://www.discord.gg/A98SNReGWD). We would be happy to help! ### Installation **Rooted**: 1. Install the APK from the releases page 2. Turn on the module in LSPosed and enable it for Spotify 3. Force stop Spotify 4. Download some extensions and make Spotify yours! **Non Rooted**: Spotify will not let you sign in on newer Spotify versions, so you will have to install a really old version of Spotify first that does not have Google Play Integrity, then you can update to the latest version 1. Download [this](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/spotify-ab/spotify-music-podcasts/spotify-music-and-podcasts-9-0-82-1008-release/) version of Spotify (v9.0.82.1008) 2. Setup [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) with this version of [Shizuku](https://github.com/thedjchi/Shizuku) 3. Press New Patch button -> Folder icon in top right -> select Spotify v9.0.82.1008 APK that you installed 4. Keep local patch mode and press patch, then install. LSPatch may prompt you to uninstall Spotify, this is required. 5. Once your patched Spotify is installed, sign in 6. Once you are signed into Spotify, you can patch Spotify again with the newer version. You can download the latest supported version of Spotify [here](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/spotify-ab/spotify-music-podcasts/spotify-music-and-podcasts-9-1-94-1929-release/). Again, go to LSPatch, new patch, folder icon, find your newer Spotify APK, local patch, and press patch and install. 7. Finally, you can go to the "Manage" tab in LSpatch, find Spotify, and select Spotify Plus from the list of modules. 8. Force stop Spotify, open, and you should be good to go! Download some extensions and make Spotify yours! ## Community Join the Spotify Plus community! We have an amazing [Discord server](https://www.discord.gg/A98SNReGWD) you can join. You can find support, give feedback, keep up with updates, or just have a friendly chat. We also have a [Telegram](https://t.me/spotifypluscool), if that is more your style. ## Credit - [JingMatrix/Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) - Main Xposed framework - [LuckyPray/DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) - Dex parsing library, used for wide Spotify compatibility - [surfbryce/beautiful-lyrics](https://github.com/surfbryce/beautiful-lyrics) - The project that made me want to develop this module, also helped structure the lyrics - [Spicetify](https://github.com/spicetify/cli) - The other project that made me want to develop this module, also gave me good ideas on what to actually add to the API ## Donating I started developing Spotify Plus because I thought Spotify could be so much more. It all started when I used the beautiful lyrics extension by surfbryce. It changed how I viewed music and how we can experience it, and from then on, I wanted to bring that experience to mobile. Spotify Plus is developed in my free time, and it will always remain free and open source. If you like my mission and what I'm building, and want to help support development, you can [sponsor](https://github.com/sponsors/LeNerd46) my profile on GitHub, or you can use the [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/lenerd46). By no means is it required, but any amount is appreciated ♥ ---
Made with ♥ and 🎵 by Devon Shoutz
Spotify Plus is not affiliated with Spotify.

# Spotify Plus Xpose 模块可在 Android 上定制官方 Spotify 应用程序 ![GitHub 下载](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.lenerd46.spotifyplus/total) ![GitHub Repo 星星](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LeNerd46/SpotifyPlus) ![静态徽章](https://img.shields.io/discord/1507540683429384233?logo=discord) ![电报徽章](https://telegram-badge.vercel.app/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@spotifypluscool) ![静态徽章](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spotify%20Version-9.1.94.1929-green?logo=spotify) ![GitHub 发布](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/LeNerd46/SpotifyPlus?color=lightgreen) > [!重要] > 最新推荐使用的 Spotify 版本是 v9.1.94.1929。不保证该模块可以在该版本之后正常工作 ### 特点 * 更改 Spotify 的颜色和主题 * 安装自定义扩展 * 修改、扩展 Spotify 并添加新功能 * 完全控制 Spotify 应用程序并使其成为您自己的应用程序 --- 有兴趣开发扩展吗？查看[文档](https://lenerd46.github.io/spotifyplus-docs/docs/category/getting-started)！如果您需要任何帮助或有任何疑问，请随时联系 [Discord](https://www.discord.gg/A98SNReGWD)。我们很乐意提供帮助！ ### 安装 **已扎根**： 1. 从发布页面安装APK 2.在LSPosed中打开该模块并为Spotify启用 3.强制停止Spotify 4. 下载一些扩展程序，让 Spotify 成为您的！ **非root**： Spotify 不会让您登录较新的 Spotify 版本，因此您必须先安装没有 Google Play Integrity 的非常旧的 Spotify 版本，然后才能更新到最新版本 1. 下载[此](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/spotify-ab/spotify-music-podcasts/spotify-music-and-podcasts-9-0-82-1008-release/)版本的Spotify (v9.0.82.1008) 2. 使用此版本的[Shizuku](https://github.com/thedjchi/Shizuku)设置[LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) 3. 按“新建补丁”按钮 -> 右上角的文件夹图标 -> 选择您安装的 Spotify v9.0.82.1008 APK 4.保持本地补丁模式并按补丁，然后安装。 LSPatch 可能会提示您卸载 Spotify，这是必需的。 5. 安装修补后的 Spotify 后，登录 6. 登录 Spotify 后，您可以使用新版本再次修补 Spotify。您可以[此处](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/spotify-ab/spotify-music-podcasts/spotify-music-and-podcasts-9-1-94-1929-release/)下载最新支持的Spotify版本。再次转到 LSPatch、新补丁、文件夹图标，找到较新的 Spotify APK、本地补丁，然后按补丁并安装。 7. 最后，您可以转到LSpatch中的“管理”选项卡，找到Spotify，然后从模块列表中选择Spotify Plus。 8. 强行停止 Spotify，打开，然后就可以开始了！下载一些扩展程序，让 Spotify 成为您的！ ## 社区 加入 Spotify Plus 社区！我们有一个令人惊叹的 [Discord 服务器](https://www.discord.gg/A98SNReGWD) 您可以加入。您可以寻求支持、提供反馈、了解最新动态，或者只是进行友好的聊天。我们还有 [Telegram](https://t.me/spotifypluscool)，如果这更符合您的风格。 ## 信用 - [JingMatrix/Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) - 主要Xposed框架 - [LuckyPray/DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) - Dex 解析库，用于广泛的 Spotify 兼容性 - [surfbryce/beautiful-lyrics](https://github.com/surfbryce/beautiful-lyrics) - 让我想要开发的项目 该模块还有助于构建歌词 - [Spicetify](https://github.com/spicetify/cli) - T让我想要开发这个模块的另一个项目也给了我关于实际添加到 API 的内容的好主意 ## 捐赠 我开始开发 Spotify Plus 是因为我认为 Spotify 可以做得更多。一切都开始于我使用 surfbryce 的美丽歌词扩展。它改变了我看待音乐的方式以及我们体验音乐的方式，从那时起，我 希望将这种体验带到移动设备上。 Spotify Plus 是我在空闲时间开发的，它将始终保持免费和开源。如果你喜欢我的使命并且 我正在构建什么，并且想要帮助支持开发，您可以[赞助](https://github.com/sponsors/LeNerd46)我在 GitHub 上的个人资料，或者您可以使用 [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/lenerd46)。绝不是必需的，但是 任何金额都表示赞赏♥ --- 由 Devon Soutz 用 ♥ 和 🎵 制作
Spotify Plus 不隶属于 Spotify。
